142: 
143: class ContextAnalyzer:
144:     """Analisador de contexto que produz DemandProfile."""
145: 
146:     def analyze(self, task: str) -> DemandProfile:
147:         """Analisa descrição da tarefa e produz perfil de demanda."""
148:         text = task.lower()
149:         tokens = text.split()
150:         file_hints = self._extract_file_hints(task)
151: 
152:         complexity = self._classify_complexity(text)
153:         domain = self._classify_domain(text)
154:         capabilities = self._extract_capabilities(text, domain)
155:         confidence = self._calculate_confidence(text, complexity, domain)
156: 
157:         profile = DemandProfile(
158:             raw=task,
159:             complexity=complexity,
160:             domain=domain,
161:             capabilities=capabilities,
162:             confidence=confidence,
163:             token_count=len(tokens),
164:             file_hints=file_hints,
165:             route=self._determine_route(complexity, domain),
166:         )
167:         return profile
168: 
169:     def _classify_complexity(self, text: str) -> Complexity:
170:         """Classifica complexidade baseado em palavras-chave."""
171:         scores: dict[Complexity, int] = {c: 0 for c in Complexity}
172: 
173:         for complexity, keywords in COMPLEXITY_KEYWORDS.items():
174:             for kw in keywords:
175:                 if kw.lower() in text:
176:                     scores[complexity] += 1
177: 
178:         # Peso maior para níveis mais altos
179:         weighted = {
180:             Complexity.TRIVIAL: scores[Complexity.TRIVIAL] * 1,
181:             Complexity.SIMPLE: scores[Complexity.SIMPLE] * 2,
182:             Complexity.MEDIUM: scores[Complexity.MEDIUM] * 3,
183:             Complexity.COMPLEX: scores[Complexity.COMPLEX] * 4,
184:             Complexity.CRITICAL: scores[Complexity.CRITICAL] * 5,
185:             Complexity.FEATURE: scores[Complexity.FEATURE] * 3,
186:         }
187: 
188:         # Nenhum match → SIMPLE (default seguro)
189:         if all(v == 0 for v in weighted.values()):
190:             return Complexity.SIMPLE
191: 
192:         return max(weighted, key=weighted.get)  # type: ignore
193: 
194:     def _classify_domain(self, text: str) -> TaskDomain:
195:         """Classifica domínio baseado em palavras-chave."""
196:         scores: dict[TaskDomain, int] = {d: 0 for d in TaskDomain}
197: 
198:         for domain, keywords in DOMAIN_KEYWORDS.items():
199:             for kw in keywords:
200:                 count = text.count(kw.lower())
201:                 if count > 0:
202:                     scores[domain] += count
203: 
204:         if all(v == 0 for v in scores.values()):
205:             return TaskDomain.UNKNOWN
206: 
207:         return max(scores, key=scores.get)  # type: ignore
208: 
209:     def _extract_file_hints(self, task: str) -> list[str]:
210:         """Extrai menções a arquivos na tarefa."""
211:         patterns = [
212:             r'`([^`]+)`',           # backticks: `arquivo.py`
213:             r'[\w./]+\.\w{1,4}',     # extensões: arquivo.py, path/to/file.ts
214:         ]
215:         hints: list[str] = []
216:         for pattern in patterns:
217:             hints.extend(re.findall(pattern, task))
218:         seen: set[str] = set()
219:         unique: list[str] = []
220:         for h in hints:
221:             if h not in seen:
222:                 seen.add(h)
223:                 unique.append(h)
224:         return unique
225: 
226:     def _extract_capabilities(self, text: str, domain: TaskDomain) -> list[str]:
227:         """Extrai capacidades necessárias baseado no domínio e texto."""
228:         capabilities = {
229:             "code": ["read", "write", "edit", "bash"],
230:             "debug": ["read", "bash", "debug"],
231:             "refactor": ["read", "write", "edit", "bash"],
232:             "test": ["read", "write", "bash", "test"],
233:             "architecture": ["read", "write", "diagram"],
234:             "docs": ["read", "write", "docs"],
235:             "research": ["read", "websearch", "explore"],
236:             "review": ["read", "diff"],
237:             "security": ["read", "bash", "security"],
238:             "devops": ["read", "bash", "deploy"],
239:             "data": ["read", "write", "bash", "query"],
240:         }
241:         return capabilities.get(domain.value, ["read", "write"])
242: 
243:     def _calculate_confidence(self, text: str, complexity: Complexity, domain: TaskDomain) -> float:
244:         """Calcula confiança na classificação."""
245:         score = 0.5  # base
246:         # Mais palavras-chave = maior confiança
247:         for kw_list in COMPLEXITY_KEYWORDS.values():
248:             if any(kw.lower() in text for kw in kw_list):
249:                 score += 0.1
250:         if domain != TaskDomain.UNKNOWN:
251:             score += 0.2
252:         return min(score, 1.0)
253: 
254:     def _determine_route(self, complexity: Complexity, domain: TaskDomain) -> str:
255:         """Determina rota de execução."""
256:         routes = {
257:             Complexity.TRIVIAL: "inline",
258:             Complexity.SIMPLE: "atlas",
259:             Complexity.MEDIUM: "prometheus → atlas",
260:             Complexity.COMPLEX: "prometheus → superpowers → atlas → hephaestus",
261:             Complexity.CRITICAL: "prometheus → superpowers → atlas → hephaestus [escalation]",
262:             Complexity.FEATURE: "Cascade Pipeline (zipper)",
263:         }
264:         return routes.get(complexity, "unknown")
265: 
266:

268: _default_analyzer = ContextAnalyzer()

270:

273:     return _default_analyzer.analyze(task)

1: """CapabilityIndex v1.0 — Resolve pipeline ótimo a partir de DemandProfile.
2: 
3: Algoritmo greedy cover: dada uma lista de capacidades necessárias e
4: os manifests dos agentes/skills, encontra a combinação que cobre
5: todas as capacidades com menor custo.
6: """
7: 
8: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
9: from typing import Optional
10: import yaml
11: import os
12: import glob
13: 
14: 
15: @dataclass
16: class ManifestEntry:
17:     """Entrada de manifesto (agente ou skill)"""
18:     name: str
19:     type: str  # "agent" | "skill"
20:     capabilities: list[str]
21:     complexity_max: str  # "TRIVIAL" | "SIMPLE" | "MEDIUM" | "COMPLEX" | "CRITICAL"
22:     cost: float = 1.0
23:     dependencies: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
24:     mcp_required: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
25:     path: str = ""
26: 
27: 
28: @dataclass
29: class Pipeline:
30:     """Pipeline resolvido de agentes + skills"""
31:     agent: Optional[ManifestEntry] = None
32:     skills: list[ManifestEntry] = field(default_factory=list)
33:     uncovered: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
34:     total_cost: float = 0.0
35:     gaps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
36: 
37:     @property
38:     def is_complete(self) -> bool:
39:         return len(self.uncovered) == 0
40: 
41:     def to_dict(self) -> dict:
42:         return {
43:             "agent": self.agent.name if self.agent else None,
44:             "skills": [s.name for s in self.skills],
45:             "uncovered": self.uncovered,
46:             "total_cost": self.total_cost,
47:             "gaps": self.gaps,
48:         }
49: 
50: 
51: class CapabilityIndex:
52:     """Índice de capacidades com greedy cover para resolução de pipeline.
53: 
54:     Scaneia diretórios de manifests em YAML e constrói um índice
55:     pesquisável de agentes e skills por capacidade.
56:     """
57: 
58:     def __init__(self):
59:         self.agents: dict[str, ManifestEntry] = {}
60:         self.skills: dict[str, ManifestEntry] = {}
61:         self._loaded = False
62: 
63:     def load_directory(self, path: str) -> int:
64:         """Carrega manifests de um diretório.
65: 
66:         Args:
67:             path: Caminho para diretório com arquivos YAML.
68: 
69:         Returns:
70:             Número de manifests carregados.
71:         """
72:         count = 0
73:         if not os.path.isdir(path):
74:             return 0
75: 
76:         for yaml_file in glob.glob(os.path.join(path, "*.yaml")) + \
77:                           glob.glob(os.path.join(path, "*.yml")):
78:             try:
79:                 with open(yaml_file) as f:
80:                     data = yaml.safe_load(f)
81:                 if not data:
82:                     continue
83:                 entry = ManifestEntry(
84:                     name=data.get("name", os.path.basename(yaml_file)),
85:                     type=data.get("type", "skill"),
86:                     capabilities=data.get("capabilities", []),
87:                     complexity_max=data.get("complexity_max", "COMPLEX"),
88:                     cost=data.get("cost", 1.0),
89:                     dependencies=data.get("dependencies", []),
90:                     mcp_required=data.get("mcp_required", []),
91:                     path=yaml_file,
92:                 )
93:                 if entry.type == "agent":
94:                     self.agents[entry.name] = entry
95:                 else:
96:                     self.skills[entry.name] = entry
97:                 count += 1
98:             except (yaml.YAMLError, IOError) as e:
99:                 print(f"Erro ao carregar {yaml_file}: {e}")
100: 
101:         if count > 0:
102:             self._loaded = True
103:         return count
104: 
105:     def register_manifest(self, entry: ManifestEntry) -> None:
106:         """Registra um manifesto programaticamente."""
107:         if entry.type == "agent":
108:             self.agents[entry.name] = entry
109:         else:
110:             self.skills[entry.name] = entry
111:         self._loaded = True
112: 
113:     def resolve(self, capabilities: list[str], complexity: str) -> Pipeline:
114:         """Resolve pipeline ótimo usando greedy cover.
115: 
116:         Args:
117:             capabilities: Lista de capacidades necessárias.
118:             complexity: Nível de complexidade da tarefa.
119: 
120:         Returns:
121:             Pipeline com agente + skills que cobrem as capacidades.
122:         """
123:         pipeline = Pipeline()
124: 
125:         # 1. Encontra melhor agente
126:         uncovered = set(capabilities)
127:         best_agent = None
128:         best_cover = 0
129: 
130:         for agent in self.agents.values():
131:             agent_caps = set(agent.capabilities)
132:             cover = len(agent_caps & uncovered)
133: 
134:             # Verifica se agente suporta a complexidade
135:             complexity_levels = ["TRIVIAL", "SIMPLE", "MEDIUM", "COMPLEX", "CRITICAL"]
136:             if complexity in complexity_levels:
137:                 agent_max = complexity_levels.index(agent.complexity_max)
138:                 task_level = complexity_levels.index(complexity)
139:                 if agent_max < task_level:
140:                     continue  # Agente não suporta esta complexidade
141: 
142:             if cover > best_cover or (cover == best_cover and agent.cost < (best_agent.cost if best_agent else float('inf'))):
143:                 best_cover = cover
144:                 best_agent = agent
145: 
146:         if best_agent:
147:             pipeline.agent = best_agent
148:             uncovered -= set(best_agent.capabilities)
149:             pipeline.total_cost += best_agent.cost
150: 
151:         # 2. Completa com skills (greedy)
152:         while uncovered:
153:             best_skill = None
154:             best_cover = 0
155: 
156:             for skill in self.skills.values():
157:                 if skill in pipeline.skills:
158:                     continue
159:                 skill_caps = set(skill.capabilities)
160:                 cover = len(skill_caps & uncovered)
161:                 if cover > best_cover or (cover == best_cover and skill.cost < (best_skill.cost if best_skill else float('inf'))):
162:                     best_cover = cover
163:                     best_skill = skill
164: 
165:             if best_skill and best_cover > 0:
166:                 pipeline.skills.append(best_skill)
167:                 uncovered -= set(best_skill.capabilities)
168:                 pipeline.total_cost += best_skill.cost
169:             else:
170:                 break
171: 
172:         pipeline.uncovered = list(uncovered)
173: 
174:         # 3. Verifica gaps de MCP
175:         for entry in [pipeline.agent] + pipeline.skills:
176:             if entry:
177:                 for mcp in entry.mcp_required:
178:                     pipeline.gaps.append(f"MCP '{mcp}' required by {entry.name}")
179: 
180:         return pipeline
181: 
182:     @property
183:     def loaded(self) -> bool:
184:         return self._loaded
185: 
186:     def stats(self) -> dict:
187:         """Estatísticas do índice."""
188:         return {
189:             "agents": len(self.agents),
190:             "skills": len(self.skills),
191:             "total_capabilities": len(set(
192:                 c for a in self.agents.values() for c in a.capabilities
193:             ) | set(c for s in self.skills.values() for c in s.capabilities)),
194:         }
195: 
196: 
197: # Singleton
198: _default_index = CapabilityIndex()
199: 
200: 
201: def resolve_pipeline(capabilities: list[str], complexity: str = "MEDIUM") -> Pipeline:
202:     """Resolve pipeline usando o índice padrão."""
203:     return _default_index.resolve(capabilities, complexity)

1: """manifest_api.py — API REST automática dos manifests YAML.
2: 
3: Antropofagia do PostgREST do Supabase:
4: Assim como o Supabase gera API REST automática do schema SQL,
5: este módulo gera API JSON automática dos manifests YAML do Gran-Mestre.
6:

8:     from native.manifest_api import ManifestAPI

11:     api.load_all()

14:     agents = api.agents()

16:     # Buscar skills por capacidade

18:     
19:     # Query: agentes que suportam COMPLEX
20:     complex_agents = api.query(type="agent", complexity_max="COMPLEX")
21: """
22: 
23: import os
24: import glob
25: import json
26: import yaml
27: from typing import Optional
28: 
29: 
30: class ManifestAPI:
31:     """API REST-style para consulta de manifests.
32:     
33:     Inspirada no PostgREST do Supabase: auto-descoberta do schema,
34:     filtros por campo, projeção de colunas.
35:     """
36: 
37:     def __init__(self, manifests_dir: str = ""):
38:         if not manifests_dir:
39:             self.manifests_dir = os.path.expanduser(
40:                 "~/.opencode/skills/gran-mestre/manifests"
41:             )
42:         else:
43:             self.manifests_dir = manifests_dir
44:         self._entries: list[dict] = []
45:         self._indexed: bool = False
46: 
47:     def load_all(self) -> list[dict]:
48:         """Carrega todos os manifests do diretório."""
49:         self._entries = []
50:         pattern = os.path.join(self.manifests_dir, "*.yaml")
51:         for path in glob.glob(pattern):
52:             try:
53:                 with open(path) as f:
54:                     data = yaml.safe_load(f)
55:                 if data:
56:                     data["_path"] = path
57:                     self._entries.append(data)
58:             except (yaml.YAMLError, IOError) as e:
59:                 print(f"Erro: {path}: {e}")
60:         self._indexed = True
61:         return self._entries
62: 
63:     # --- Métodos Query (como PostgREST) ---
64: 
65:     def agents(self) -> list[dict]:
66:         """Retorna todos os agentes."""
67:         return self.query(type="agent")
68: 
69:     def skills(self) -> list[dict]:
70:         """Retorna todas as skills."""
71:         return self.query(type="skill")
72: 
73:     def filter_capability(self, capability: str) -> list[dict]:
74:         """Filtra por capacidade (como ?capability=eq.security)."""
75:         return [
76:             e for e in self._entries
77:             if capability in e.get("capabilities", [])
78:         ]
79: 
80:     def filter_complexity(self, max_level: str) -> list[dict]:
81:         """Filtra por nível máximo de complexidade."""
82:         levels = ["TRIVIAL", "SIMPLE", "MEDIUM", "COMPLEX", "CRITICAL"]
83:         if max_level not in levels:
84:             raise ValueError(f"Invalid level: {max_level}")
85:         max_idx = levels.index(max_level)
86:         return [
87:             e for e in self._entries
88:             if levels.index(e.get("complexity_max", "COMPLEX")) <= max_idx
89:         ]
90: 
91:     def query(self, **filters) -> list[dict]:
92:         """Query flexível: query(type="agent", complexity_max="COMPLEX")."""
93:         results = list(self._entries)
94:         for key, value in filters.items():
95:             results = [e for e in results if e.get(key) == value]
96:         return results
97: 
98:     def select(self, fields: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
99:         """Projeção de campos (como ?select=name,type)."""
100:         return [
101:             {k: v for k, v in e.items() if k in fields}
102:             for e in self._entries
103:         ]
104: 
105:     def get(self, name: str) -> Optional[dict]:
106:         """Busca por nome exato."""
107:         for e in self._entries:
108:             if e.get("name") == name:
109:                 return e
110:         return None
111: 
112:     def search(self, term: str) -> list[dict]:
113:         """Busca textual em todos os campos."""
114:         term_lower = term.lower()
115:         results = []
116:         for e in self._entries:
117:             for v in e.values():
118:                 if isinstance(v, str) and term_lower in v.lower():
119:                     results.append(e)
120:                     break
121:                 if isinstance(v, list) and any(term_lower in str(item).lower() for item in v):
122:                     results.append(e)
123:                     break
124:         return results
125: 
126:     def stats(self) -> dict:
127:         """Estatísticas dos manifests carregados."""
128:         agents = self.agents()
129:         skills = self.skills()
130:         all_caps = set()
131:         for e in self._entries:
132:             all_caps.update(e.get("capabilities", []))
133:         return {
134:             "total": len(self._entries),
135:             "agents": len(agents),
136:             "skills": len(skills),
137:             "unique_capabilities": len(all_caps),
138:             "capabilities": sorted(all_caps),
139:         }
140: 
141:     def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
142:         """Exporta todos os manifests como JSON."""
143:         return json.dumps(self._entries, indent=indent)
144: 
145:     @property
146:     def loaded(self) -> bool:
147:         return self._indexed
148: 
149: 
150: # Singleton
151: _default_api = ManifestAPI()
152: 
153: 
154: def load_manifests() -> list[dict]:
155:     """Carrega manifests usando API padrão."""
156:     return _default_api.load_all()
157: 
158: 
159: def query_manifests(**filters) -> list[dict]:
160:     """Query manifests usando API padrão."""
161:     if not _default_api.loaded:
162:         _default_api.load_all()
163:     return _default_api.query(**filters)

1: """RetryClassifier v1.0 — Classifica erros em 8 categorias com política de retry.
2: 
3: Cada erro é classificado em uma categoria previsível, permitindo decisão
4: inteligente sobre retentar, escalar ou falhar.
5: """
6: 
7: import re
8: from enum import Enum, auto
9: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
10: from typing import Optional
11: 
12: 
13: class ErrorCategory(Enum):
14:     """Categorias de erro classificáveis"""
15:     NETWORK = auto()          # Timeout, conexão recusada, DNS
16:     API_RATE_LIMIT = auto()   # 429, rate limiting
17:     API_AUTH = auto()         # 401, 403, token expirado
18:     API_SERVER = auto()       # 500, 502, 503
19:     VALIDATION = auto()       # Erro de validação (não recuperável)
20:     RESOURCE = auto()         # Arquivo não encontrado, diretório não existe
21:     TIMEOUT = auto()          # Timeout de operação
22:     UNKNOWN = auto()          # Não classificado
23: 
24: 
25: @dataclass
26: class RetryPolicy:
27:     """Política de retry para uma categoria de erro"""
28:     max_attempts: int
29:     base_delay: float       # segundos
30:     backoff_factor: float   # multiplicador a cada tentativa
31:     max_delay: float        # teto máximo
32:     retryable: bool         # se deve tentar novamente
33: 
34: 
35: # Políticas padrão por categoria
36: DEFAULT_POLICIES: dict[ErrorCategory, RetryPolicy] = {
37:     ErrorCategory.NETWORK: RetryPolicy(
38:         max_attempts=3, base_delay=1.0, backoff_factor=2.0,
39:         max_delay=30.0, retryable=True
40:     ),
41:     ErrorCategory.API_RATE_LIMIT: RetryPolicy(
42:         max_attempts=3, base_delay=2.0, backoff_factor=2.0,
43:         max_delay=60.0, retryable=True
44:     ),
45:     ErrorCategory.API_AUTH: RetryPolicy(
46:         max_attempts=1, base_delay=0.0, backoff_factor=1.0,
47:         max_delay=0.0, retryable=False
48:     ),
49:     ErrorCategory.API_SERVER: RetryPolicy(
50:         max_attempts=3, base_delay=2.0, backoff_factor=2.0,
51:         max_delay=30.0, retryable=True
52:     ),
53:     ErrorCategory.VALIDATION: RetryPolicy(
54:         max_attempts=1, base_delay=0.0, backoff_factor=1.0,
55:         max_delay=0.0, retryable=False
56:     ),
57:     ErrorCategory.RESOURCE: RetryPolicy(
58:         max_attempts=2, base_delay=0.5, backoff_factor=1.0,
59:         max_delay=5.0, retryable=True
60:     ),
61:     ErrorCategory.TIMEOUT: RetryPolicy(
62:         max_attempts=2, base_delay=1.0, backoff_factor=2.0,
63:         max_delay=15.0, retryable=True
64:     ),
65:     ErrorCategory.UNKNOWN: RetryPolicy(
66:         max_attempts=1, base_delay=0.0, backoff_factor=1.0,
67:         max_delay=0.0, retryable=False
68:     ),
69: }
70: 
71: 
72: # Padrões de regex para classificação automática
73: ERROR_PATTERNS: dict[ErrorCategory, list[re.Pattern]] = {
74:     ErrorCategory.NETWORK: [
75:         re.compile(r"connection refused|connection reset|broken pipe", re.I),
76:         re.compile(r"timeout.*(?:connection|connect)", re.I),
77:         re.compile(r"dns.*(?:error|fail)|name resolution", re.I),
78:         re.compile(r"network (?:error|unreachable|down)", re.I),
79:         re.compile(r"econnrefused|econnreset|etimedout", re.I),
80:     ],
81:     ErrorCategory.API_RATE_LIMIT: [
82:         re.compile(r"429|rate limit|too many requests", re.I),
83:         re.compile(r"retry after|try again later", re.I),
84:     ],
85:     ErrorCategory.API_AUTH: [
86:         re.compile(r"401|403|unauthorized|forbidden", re.I),
87:         re.compile(r"token (?:invalid|expired|revoked)", re.I),
88:         re.compile(r"api key|authentication failed", re.I),
89:     ],
90:     ErrorCategory.API_SERVER: [
91:         re.compile(r"50[0-9]", re.I),
92:         re.compile(r"internal server error|service unavailable", re.I),
93:         re.compile(r"bad gateway|gateway timeout", re.I),
94:     ],
95:     ErrorCategory.VALIDATION: [
96:         re.compile(r"400|422|validation error|invalid input", re.I),
97:         re.compile(r"typeerror|valueerror|keyerror", re.I),
98:         re.compile(r"syntax error|parse error", re.I),
99:     ],
100:     ErrorCategory.RESOURCE: [
101:         re.compile(r"not found|filenotfound|no such file|does not exist", re.I),
102:         re.compile(r"permission denied|eacces|ero fs", re.I),
103:         re.compile(r"no space left|disk full|enospc", re.I),
104:     ],
105:     ErrorCategory.TIMEOUT: [
106:         re.compile(r"timeout|timed out", re.I),
107:         re.compile(r"deadline exceeded|context deadline", re.I),
108:     ],
109: }
110: 
111: 
112: @dataclass
113: class ClassifiedError:
114:     """Erro classificado com política de retry"""
115:     original: str
116:     category: ErrorCategory
117:     policy: RetryPolicy
118:     attempt: int = 0
119:     suggestion: Optional[str] = None
120: 
121:     @property
122:     def should_retry(self) -> bool:
123:         return self.policy.retryable and self.attempt < self.policy.max_attempts
124: 
125:     @property
126:     def next_delay(self) -> float:
127:         delay = self.policy.base_delay * (self.policy.backoff_factor ** self.attempt)
128:         return min(delay, self.policy.max_delay)
129: 
130:     @property
131:     def exhausted(self) -> bool:
132:         return self.attempt >= self.policy.max_attempts
133: 
134: 
135: class RetryClassifier:
136:     """Classificador de erros com política de retry configurável"""
137: 
138:     def __init__(self, policies: Optional[dict[ErrorCategory, RetryPolicy]] = None):
139:         self.policies = {**DEFAULT_POLICIES, **(policies or {})}
140: 
141:     def classify(self, error: str) -> ErrorCategory:
142:         """Classifica uma string de erro em uma categoria."""
143:         for category, patterns in ERROR_PATTERNS.items():
144:             for pattern in patterns:
145:                 if pattern.search(str(error)):
146:                     return category
147:         return ErrorCategory.UNKNOWN
148: 
149:     def analyze(self, error: str, attempt: int = 0) -> ClassifiedError:
150:         """Analisa erro e retorna classificação completa com política."""
151:         category = self.classify(error)
152:         policy = self.policies.get(category, DEFAULT_POLICIES[ErrorCategory.UNKNOWN])
153:         suggestion = self._get_suggestion(category, error)
154:         return ClassifiedError(
155:             original=error,
156:             category=category,
157:             policy=policy,
158:             attempt=attempt,
159:             suggestion=suggestion,
160:         )
161: 
162:     def _get_suggestion(self, category: ErrorCategory, error: str) -> Optional[str]:
163:         """Gera sugestão de ação baseada na categoria."""
164:         suggestions = {
165:             ErrorCategory.NETWORK: "Verifique conexão de rede e tente novamente",
166:             ErrorCategory.API_RATE_LIMIT: "Aguarde o período de rate limit e tente com backoff",
167:             ErrorCategory.API_AUTH: "Verifique credenciais e renovação de token",
168:             ErrorCategory.API_SERVER: "O servidor pode estar sobrecarregado, tente novamente",
169:             ErrorCategory.VALIDATION: "Revise os parâmetros da requisição",
170:             ErrorCategory.RESOURCE: "Verifique se o recurso existe e as permissões",
171:             ErrorCategory.TIMEOUT: "A operação excedeu o tempo limite",
172:         }
173:         return suggestions.get(category)
174: 
175: 
176: # Instância singleton
177: _default_classifier = RetryClassifier()
178: 
179: 
180: def classify_error(error: str, attempt: int = 0) -> ClassifiedError:
181:     """Classifica erro usando o classificador padrão."""
182:     return _default_classifier.analyze(error, attempt)

1: """TraceContext v1.0 — UUID4 execution_id propagation for Gran-Mestre pipelines.
2: 
3: Cada execução recebe um UUID4 único que é propagado para todos os spans filhos.
4: Permite rastrear uma requisição do início ao fim através de todos os agentes.
5: """
6: 
7: import uuid
8: import time
9: import json
10: import os
11: from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
12: from typing import Optional
13: 
14: 
15: @dataclass
16: class TraceSpan:
17:     """Um span individual dentro de uma execução"""
18:     span_id: str
19:     parent_id: Optional[str]
20:     agent: str
21:     action: str
22:     start_time: float
23:     end_time: Optional[float] = None
24:     status: str = "pending"
25:     error: Optional[str] = None
26:     metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
27: 
28: 
29: class TraceContext:
30:     """Contexto de rastreamento para uma execução do Gran-Mestre.
31: 
32:     Uso:
33:         trace = TraceContext.new("gran-mestre", "decompose")
34:         trace.start_span("prometheus", "plan")
35:         # ... trabalho ...
36:         trace.end_span(status="success")
37:         trace.save()
38:     """
39: 
40:     _instance: Optional["TraceContext"] = None
41: 
42:     def __init__(self, execution_id: str, agent: str, action: str):
43:         self.execution_id = execution_id
44:         self.root_agent = agent
45:         self.root_action = action
46:         self.start_time = time.time()
47:         self.end_time: Optional[float] = None
48:         self.spans: list[TraceSpan] = []
49:         self._current_span: Optional[TraceSpan] = None
50:         self.status: str = "running"
51:         self.metadata: dict = {}
52: 
53:         # Span raiz
54:         self.start_span(agent, action)
55: 
56:     @classmethod
57:     def new(cls, agent: str = "gran-mestre", action: str = "pipeline") -> "TraceContext":
58:         """Cria nova execução com ID único"""
59:         execution_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
60:         instance = cls(execution_id, agent, action)
61:         TraceContext._instance = instance
62:         return instance
63: 
64:     @classmethod
65:     def get(cls) -> Optional["TraceContext"]:
66:         """Retorna instância atual (thread-local)"""
67:         return cls._instance
68: 
69:     @classmethod
70:     def reset(cls) -> None:
71:         cls._instance = None
72: 
73:     def start_span(self, agent: str, action: str) -> str:
74:         """Inicia um novo span filho"""
75:         span_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
76:         parent_id = self._current_span.span_id if self._current_span else None
77:         span = TraceSpan(
78:             span_id=span_id,
79:             parent_id=parent_id,
80:             agent=agent,
81:             action=action,
82:             start_time=time.time(),
83:         )
84:         self.spans.append(span)
85:         self._current_span = span
86:         return span_id
87: 
88:     def end_span(self, status: str = "success", error: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
89:         """Finaliza o span atual"""
90:         if self._current_span:
91:             self._current_span.end_time = time.time()
92:             self._current_span.status = status
93:             self._current_span.error = error
94:             # Volta para o pai
95:             if self._current_span.parent_id:
96:                 parent = next(
97:                     (s for s in self.spans if s.span_id == self._current_span.parent_id),
98:                     None
99:                 )
100:                 self._current_span = parent
101:             else:
102:                 self._current_span = None
103: 
104:     def add_metadata(self, key: str, value: object) -> None:
105:         """Adiciona metadado à execução"""
106:         self.metadata[key] = value
107:         if self._current_span:
108:             self._current_span.metadata[key] = value
109: 
110:     def finish(self, status: str = "success") -> dict:
111:         """Finaliza toda a execução"""
112:         while self._current_span:
113:             self.end_span()
114:         self.end_time = time.time()
115:         self.status = status
116:         return self.to_dict()
117: 
118:     @property
119:     def duration_ms(self) -> float:
120:         end = self.end_time or time.time()
121:         return (end - self.start_time) * 1000
122: 
123:     def to_dict(self) -> dict:
124:         return {
125:             "execution_id": self.execution_id,
126:             "root_agent": self.root_agent,
127:             "root_action": self.root_action,
128:             "start_time": self.start_time,
129:             "end_time": self.end_time,
130:             "duration_ms": self.duration_ms,
131:             "status": self.status,
132:             "spans": [asdict(s) for s in self.spans],
133:             "metadata": self.metadata,
134:         }
135: 
136:     def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
137:         return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)
138: 
139:     def save(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
140:         """Salva trace em arquivo JSON"""
141:         if path is None:
142:             traces_dir = os.path.expanduser("~/.opencode/data/traces")
143:             os.makedirs(traces_dir, exist_ok=True)
144:             path = os.path.join(traces_dir, f"trace-{self.execution_id[:8]}.json")
145:         with open(path, "w") as f:
146:             f.write(self.to_json())
147:         return path
148: 
149:     def __repr__(self) -> str:
150:         return (
151:             f"TraceContext(id={self.execution_id[:8]}, "
152:             f"agent={self.root_agent}, "
153:             f"spans={len(self.spans)}, "
154:             f"status={self.status})"
155:         )

182:         return

1: #!/usr/bin/env python3

4: Uso:
5:     python3 mcp_health_check.py              # Testa todos
6:     python3 mcp_health_check.py --check gh   # Testa 1 específico
7:     python3 mcp_health_check.py --json       # Saída JSON
8:     python3 mcp_health_check.py --fix env    # Tenta configurar env vars
9: 
10: Formato: Ctrl+C → Ctrl+V → Ctrl+S → python3 mcp_health_check.py
11: """
12: 
13: import json
14: import os
15: import subprocess
16: import sys
17: import time
18: from typing import Optional

21: MCP_CONFIG_PATH = os.path.expanduser("~/.opencode/mcp-configs/mcp-servers.json")
22: ENV_FILE = os.path.expanduser("~/.opencode/.env")

24: # MCPs essenciais que devem funcionar sempre
25: CRITICAL_MCPS = {
26:     "playwright": "npx @playwright/mcp",
27:     "github": "npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github",
28:     "filesystem": "npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem",
29:     "memory": "Memória persistente",
30:     "context7": "Documentação ao vivo",

34: ENV_REQUIRED_MCPS = {
35:     "github": {"GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN": "token_github"},
36:     "jira": {"JIRA_URL": "url_jira", "JIRA_EMAIL": "email", "JIRA_API_TOKEN": "token"},
37:     "supabase": {"SUPABASE_URL": "url", "SUPABASE_KEY": "key"},
38:     "firecrawl": {"FIRECRAWL_API_KEY": "api_key"},
39:     "exa-web-search": {"EXA_API_KEY": "api_key"},
40: }
41: 
42: # Redundâncias detectadas
43: REDUNDANT_MCPS = {
44:     "memory": ["omega-memory", "memxus", "squish"],
45:     "cloudflare-docs": ["cloudflare-workers-builds", "cloudflare-workers-bindings"],
46: }

49: class HealthReport:
50:     """Relatório de saúde dos MCPs"""
51: 
52:     def __init__(self):
53:         self.checks: list[dict] = []
54:         self.errors: int = 0
55:         self.warnings: int = 0
56:         self.ok: int = 0
57:         self.not_configured: int = 0
58: 
59:     def add(self, name: str, status: str, detail: str = ""):
60:         entry = {"name": name, "status": status, "detail": detail}
61:         self.checks.append(entry)
62:         if status == "OK":
63:             self.ok += 1
64:         elif status == "WARN":
65:             self.warnings += 1
66:         elif status == "FAIL":
67:             self.errors += 1
68:         elif status == "NOCONF":
69:             self.not_configured += 1
70: 
71:     def to_dict(self) -> dict:
72:         return {
73:             "total": len(self.checks),
74:             "ok": self.ok,
75:             "warnings": self.warnings,
76:             "errors": self.errors,
77:             "not_configured": self.not_configured,
78:             "checks": self.checks,
79:         }
80: 
81:     def summary(self) -> str:
82:         lines = [
83:             "🔍 MCP Health Check Report",
84:             "═══════════════════════════",
85:             f"Total:  {len(self.checks):2d}",
86:             f"✅ OK:   {self.ok:2d}",
87:             f"⚠️ WARN: {self.warnings:2d}",
88:             f"❌ FAIL: {self.errors:2d}",
89:             f"⚪ NOCONF: {self.not_configured:2d}",
90:             "",
91:         ]
92:         for c in self.checks:
93:             icon = {"OK": "✅", "WARN": "⚠️", "FAIL": "❌", "NOCONF": "⚪"}.get(c["status"], "❓")
94:             lines.append(f"  {icon} {c['name']}: {c['status']} — {c['detail']}")
95: 
96:         if self.errors > 0:
97:             lines.extend([
98:                 "",
99:                 "❌ Recomendações:",
100:                 *[f"  • {c['name']}: {c['detail']}" for c in self.checks if c['status'] == 'FAIL']
101:             ])
102:         if not os.path.exists(ENV_FILE):
103:             lines.extend([
104:                 "",
105:                 f"⚠️ .env não encontrado em {ENV_FILE}",
106:                 "   Crie: cp ~/.opencode/.env.example ~/.opencode/.env",
107:             ])
108:         return "\n".join(lines)
109:

111: def load_mcp_config() -> dict:
112:     """Carrega configuração MCP."""
113:     try:
114:         with open(MCP_CONFIG_PATH) as f:
115:             return json.load(f).get("mcpServers", {})
116:     except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
117:         print(f"❌ Config MCP não encontrada em {MCP_CONFIG_PATH}")
118:         return {}

121: def test_server_available(entry: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
122:     """Testa se servidor MCP está disponível."""
123:     command = entry.get("command", "")
124:     args = entry.get("args", [])
125: 
126:     if not command:
127:         return "NOCONF", "Sem comando definido"
128: 
129:     # Testa se o binário existe
130:     if command == "npx":
131:         return "OK", "npx disponível (verificação lazy)"
132:     elif command == "uvx":
133:         return "OK", "uvx disponível (verificação lazy)"
134:     elif command == "python3":
135:         return "OK", "python3 disponível"
136:     else:
137:         try:
138:             subprocess.run(
139:                 [command, "--version"],
140:                 capture_output=True, timeout=5
141:             )
142:             return "OK", f"{command} disponível"
143:         except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
144:             return "WARN", f"{command} não encontrado"
145:         except Exception as e:
146:             return "FAIL", str(e)
147: 
148: 
149: def test_env_vars(entry: dict, name: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
150:     """Verifica se env vars necessárias estão configuradas."""
151:     env = entry.get("env", {})
152:     if not env:
153:         return "OK", "Sem env vars necessárias"
154: 
155:     configured = all(v for v in env.values() if v and not v.startswith("YOUR_"))
156:     missing = [k for k, v in env.items() if not v or v.startswith("YOUR_")]
157: 
158:     if configured:
159:         return "OK", "Env vars configuradas"
160:     elif missing:
161:         return "WARN", f"Env vars pendentes: {', '.join(missing)}"
162:     return "FAIL", "Credenciais não configuradas"
163: 
164: 
165: def run_health_check(name: str, entry: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
166:     """Executa health check completo para um MCP."""
167:     # Testa disponibilidade
168:     avail_status, avail_detail = test_server_available(entry)
169:     if avail_status in ("FAIL", "NOCONF"):
170:         return avail_status, avail_detail
171: 
172:     # Testa env vars
173:     env_status, env_detail = test_env_vars(entry, name)
174:     if env_status != "OK":
175:         return env_status, env_detail
176: 
177:     return "OK", "Funcional"

184:         return
185:

191:         "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=seu_token_aqui",
192:         "",

196:         "JIRA_API_TOKEN=seu_token_aqui",

201:         "",
202:         "# Firecrawl",

204:         "",
205:         "# Exa Web Search",
206:         "EXA_API_KEY=sua_key_aqui",
207:         "",
208:     ]

210:         f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

212: 
213: 
214: def main():
215:     fix_env = "--fix env" in sys.argv or "-f" in sys.argv
216:     json_output = "--json" in sys.argv or "-j" in sys.argv
217:     check_filter = None
218:     for arg in sys.argv[1:]:
219:         if not arg.startswith("-"):
220:             check_filter = arg

1: """mcp_bridge.py — Bridge entre browser-use skill e Playwright MCP.
2: 
3: Adaptado da arquitetura Agent+Controller do browser-use/browser-use (MIT).
4: Aplicação de antropofagia: absorvemos o padrão de agente assíncrono
5: e adaptamos para o modelo de hooks do OpenCode.
6: """
7: 
8: import json
9: import os
10: import time
11: import subprocess
12: from typing import Optional
13: 
14: 
15: class BrowserSession:
16:     """Sessão de navegador gerenciada via Playwright MCP.
17: 
18:     Abstrai a comunicação com o servidor MCP Playwright,
19:     permitindo que a skill browser-use controle o navegador.
20:     """
21: 
22:     def __init__(self, mcp_name: str = "playwright"):
23:         self.mcp_name = mcp_name
24:         self.session_id: Optional[str] = None
25:         self.screenshots_dir = "/tmp/browser-use/screenshots"
26:         os.makedirs(self.screenshots_dir, exist_ok=True)
27: 
28:     def navigate(self, url: str) -> dict:
29:         """Navega para URL."""
30:         return self._mcp_call("browser_navigate", {"url": url})
31: 
32:     def click(self, selector: str) -> dict:
33:         """Clica em elemento."""
34:         return self._mcp_call("browser_click", {"selector": selector})
35: 
36:     def fill(self, selector: str, value: str) -> dict:
37:         """Preenche campo."""
38:         return self._mcp_call("browser_fill", {"selector": selector, "value": value})
39: 
40:     def screenshot(self, name: str = "page") -> str:
41:         """Tira screenshot e salva localmente."""
42:         result = self._mcp_call("browser_screenshot", {})
43:         path = os.path.join(self.screenshots_dir, f"{name}-{int(time.time())}.png")
44:         if result.get("data"):
45:             import base64
46:             with open(path, "wb") as f:
47:                 f.write(base64.b64decode(result["data"]))
48:         return path
49: 
50:     def extract(self, selector: str) -> list[dict]:
51:         """Extrai dados estruturados de elementos."""
52:         result = self._mcp_call("browser_extract", {"selector": selector})
53:         return result.get("elements", [])
54: 
55:     def evaluate(self, script: str) -> dict:
56:         """Executa JavaScript na página."""
57:         return self._mcp_call("browser_evaluate", {"script": script})
58: 
59:     def _mcp_call(self, tool: str, args: dict) -> dict:
60:         """Chama ferramenta MCP Playwright via subprocess.
61: 
62:         NOTA: Em produção, usar MCP client SDK. Esta implementação
63:         é um bridge simplificado para integração imediata.
64:         """
65:         cmd = [
66:             "npx", "-y", "@playwright/mcp",
67:             "call", tool,
68:             "--args", json.dumps(args),
69:         ]
70:         try:
71:             result = subprocess.run(
72:                 cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30
73:             )
74:             if result.returncode == 0:
75:                 return json.loads(result.stdout)
76:             return {"error": result.stderr}
77:         except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
78:             return {"error": "Timeout na chamada MCP"}
79:         except Exception as e:
80:             return {"error": str(e)}
81: 
82:     def close(self) -> None:
83:         """Fecha sessão."""
84:         self._mcp_call("browser_close", {})
85:         self.session_id = None
86: 
87: 
88: # Singleton
89: _default_session: Optional[BrowserSession] = None
90: 
91: 
92: def get_browser() -> BrowserSession:
93:     """Retorna sessão de navegador (singleton)."""
94:     global _default_session
95:     if _default_session is None:
96:         _default_session = BrowserSession()
97:     return _default_session
98: 
99: 
100: def close_browser() -> None:
101:     """Fecha sessão de navegador."""
102:     global _default_session
103:     if _default_session:
104:         _default_session.close()
105:         _default_session = None

1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: /**
3:  * ck — Context Keeper v2
4:  * init.mjs — auto-detect project info and output JSON for Claude to confirm
5:  *
6:  * Usage: node init.mjs
7:  * stdout: JSON with auto-detected project info
8:  * exit 0: success  exit 1: error
9:  */
10: 
11: import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'fs';
12: import { resolve, basename } from 'path';
13: import { readProjects } from './shared.mjs';
14: 
15: const cwd = process.env.PWD || process.cwd();
16: const projects = readProjects();
17: 
18: const output = {
19:   path: cwd,
20:   name: null,
21:   description: null,
22:   stack: [],
23:   goal: null,
24:   constraints: [],
25:   repo: null,
26:   alreadyRegistered: !!projects[cwd],
27: };
28: 
29: function readFile(filename) {
30:   const p = resolve(cwd, filename);
31:   if (!existsSync(p)) return null;
32:   try { return readFileSync(p, 'utf8'); } catch { return null; }
33: }
34: 
35: function extractSection(md, heading) {
36:   const re = new RegExp(`## ${heading}\\n([\\s\\S]*?)(?=\\n## |$)`);
37:   const m = md.match(re);
38:   return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
39: }
40: 
41: // ── package.json ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
42: const pkg = readFile('package.json');
43: if (pkg) {
44:   try {
45:     const parsed = JSON.parse(pkg);
46:     if (parsed.name && !output.name) output.name = parsed.name;
47:     if (parsed.description && !output.description) output.description = parsed.description;
48: 
49:     // Detect stack from dependencies
50:     const deps = Object.keys({ ...(parsed.dependencies || {}), ...(parsed.devDependencies || {}) });
51:     const stackMap = {
52:       next: 'Next.js', react: 'React', vue: 'Vue', svelte: 'Svelte', astro: 'Astro',
53:       express: 'Express', fastify: 'Fastify', hono: 'Hono', nestjs: 'NestJS',
54:       typescript: 'TypeScript', prisma: 'Prisma', drizzle: 'Drizzle',
55:       '@neondatabase/serverless': 'Neon', '@upstash/redis': 'Upstash Redis',
56:       '@clerk/nextjs': 'Clerk', stripe: 'Stripe', tailwindcss: 'Tailwind CSS',
57:     };
58:     for (const [dep, label] of Object.entries(stackMap)) {
59:       if (deps.includes(dep) && !output.stack.includes(label)) {
60:         output.stack.push(label);
61:       }
62:     }
63:     if (deps.includes('typescript') || existsSync(resolve(cwd, 'tsconfig.json'))) {
64:       if (!output.stack.includes('TypeScript')) output.stack.push('TypeScript');
65:     }
66:   } catch { /* malformed package.json */ }
67: }
68: 
69: // ── go.mod ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
70: const goMod = readFile('go.mod');
71: if (goMod) {
72:   if (!output.stack.includes('Go')) output.stack.push('Go');
73:   const modName = goMod.match(/^module\s+(\S+)/m)?.[1];
74:   if (modName && !output.name) output.name = modName.split('/').pop();
75: }
76: 
77: // ── Cargo.toml ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
78: const cargo = readFile('Cargo.toml');
79: if (cargo) {
80:   if (!output.stack.includes('Rust')) output.stack.push('Rust');
81:   const crateName = cargo.match(/^name\s*=\s*"(.+?)"/m)?.[1];
82:   if (crateName && !output.name) output.name = crateName;
83: }
84: 
85: // ── pyproject.toml ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
86: const pyproject = readFile('pyproject.toml');
87: if (pyproject) {
88:   if (!output.stack.includes('Python')) output.stack.push('Python');
89:   const pyName = pyproject.match(/^name\s*=\s*"(.+?)"/m)?.[1];
90:   if (pyName && !output.name) output.name = pyName;
91: }
92: 
93: // ── .git/config (repo URL) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
94: const gitConfig = readFile('.git/config');
95: if (gitConfig) {
96:   const repoMatch = gitConfig.match(/url\s*=\s*(.+)/);
97:   if (repoMatch) output.repo = repoMatch[1].trim();
98: }
99: 
100: // ── CLAUDE.md ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
101: const claudeMd = readFile('CLAUDE.md');
102: if (claudeMd) {
103:   const goal = extractSection(claudeMd, 'Current Goal');
104:   if (goal && !output.goal) output.goal = goal.split('\n')[0].trim();
105: 
106:   const doNot = extractSection(claudeMd, 'Do Not Do');
107:   if (doNot) {
108:     const bullets = doNot.split('\n')
109:       .filter(l => /^[-*]\s+/.test(l))
110:       .map(l => l.replace(/^[-*]\s+/, '').trim());
111:     output.constraints = bullets;
112:   }
113: 
114:   const stack = extractSection(claudeMd, 'Tech Stack');
115:   if (stack && output.stack.length === 0) {
116:     output.stack = stack.split(/[,\n]/).map(s => s.replace(/^[-*]\s+/, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
117:   }
118: 
119:   // Description from first section or "What This Is"
120:   const whatItIs = extractSection(claudeMd, 'What This Is') || extractSection(claudeMd, 'About');
121:   if (whatItIs && !output.description) output.description = whatItIs.split('\n')[0].trim();
122: }
123: 
124: // ── README.md (description fallback) ─────────────────────────────────────────
125: const readme = readFile('README.md');
126: if (readme && !output.description) {
127:   // First non-header, non-badge, non-empty paragraph
128:   const lines = readme.split('\n');
129:   for (const line of lines) {
130:     const trimmed = line.trim();
131:     if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && !trimmed.startsWith('!') && !trimmed.startsWith('>') && !trimmed.startsWith('[') && trimmed !== '---' && trimmed !== '___') {
132:       output.description = trimmed.slice(0, 120);
133:       break;
134:     }
135:   }
136: }
137: 
138: // ── Name fallback: directory name ─────────────────────────────────────────────
139: if (!output.name) {
140:   output.name = basename(cwd).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
141: }
142: 
143: console.log(JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));

1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: /**
3:  * ck — Context Keeper v2
4:  * save.mjs — write session data to context.json, regenerate CONTEXT.md,
5:  *             and write a native memory entry.
6:  *
7:  * Usage (regular save):
8:  *   echo '<json>' | node save.mjs
9:  *   JSON schema: { summary, leftOff, nextSteps[], decisions[{what,why}], blockers[], goal? }
10:  *
11:  * Usage (init — first registration):
12:  *   echo '<json>' | node save.mjs --init
13:  *   JSON schema: { name, path, description, stack[], goal, constraints[], repo? }
14:  *
15:  * stdout: confirmation message
16:  * exit 0: success  exit 1: error
17:  */
18: 
19: import { readFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
20: import { resolve } from 'path';
21: import {
22:   readProjects, writeProjects, loadContext, saveContext,
23:   today, shortId, gitSummary, nativeMemoryDir,
24:   CURRENT_SESSION,
25: } from './shared.mjs';
26: 
27: const isInit = process.argv.includes('--init');
28: const cwd    = process.env.PWD || process.cwd();
29: 
30: // ── Read JSON from stdin ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
31: let input;
32: try {
33:   const raw = readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim();
34:   if (!raw) throw new Error('empty stdin');
35:   input = JSON.parse(raw);
36: } catch (e) {
37:   console.error(`ck save: invalid JSON on stdin — ${e.message}`);
38:   console.log('Expected schema (save):  {"summary":"...","leftOff":"...","nextSteps":["..."],"decisions":[{"what":"...","why":"..."}],"blockers":["..."]}');
39:   console.log('Expected schema (--init): {"name":"...","path":"...","description":"...","stack":["..."],"goal":"...","constraints":["..."]}');
40:   process.exit(1);
41: }
42: 
43: // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
44: // INIT MODE: first-time project registration
45: // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
46: if (isInit) {
47:   const { name, path: projectPath, description, stack, goal, constraints, repo } = input;
48: 
49:   if (!name || !projectPath) {
50:     console.log('ck init: name and path are required.');
51:     process.exit(1);
52:   }
53: 
54:   const projects = readProjects();
55: 
56:   // Derive contextDir (lowercase, spaces→dashes, deduplicate)
57:   let contextDir = name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '');
58:   let suffix = 2;
59:   const existingDirs = Object.values(projects).map(p => p.contextDir);
60:   while (existingDirs.includes(contextDir) && projects[projectPath]?.contextDir !== contextDir) {
61:     contextDir = `${contextDir.replace(/-\d+$/, '')}-${suffix++}`;
62:   }
63: 
64:   const context = {
65:     version: 2,
66:     name: contextDir,
67:     displayName: name,
68:     path: projectPath,
69:     description: description || null,
70:     stack: Array.isArray(stack) ? stack : (stack ? [stack] : []),
71:     goal: goal || null,
72:     constraints: Array.isArray(constraints) ? constraints : [],
73:     repo: repo || null,
74:     createdAt: today(),
75:     sessions: [],
76:   };
77: 
78:   saveContext(contextDir, context);
79: 
80:   // Update projects.json
81:   projects[projectPath] = {
82:     name,
83:     contextDir,
84:     lastUpdated: today(),
85:   };
86:   writeProjects(projects);
87: 
88:   console.log(`✓ Project '${name}' registered.`);
89:   console.log(`  Use /ck:save to save session state and /ck:resume to reload it next time.`);
90:   process.exit(0);
91: }
92: 
93: // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
94: // SAVE MODE: record a session
95: // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
96: const projects = readProjects();
97: const projectEntry = projects[cwd];
98: 
99: if (!projectEntry) {
100:   console.log("This project isn't registered yet. Run /ck:init first.");
101:   process.exit(1);
102: }
103: 
104: const { contextDir } = projectEntry;
105: let context = loadContext(contextDir);
106: 
107: if (!context) {
108:   console.log(`ck: context.json not found for '${contextDir}'. The install may be corrupted.`);
109:   process.exit(1);
110: }
111: 
112: // Get session ID from current-session.json
113: let sessionId;
114: try {
115:   const sess = JSON.parse(readFileSync(CURRENT_SESSION, 'utf8'));
116:   sessionId = sess.sessionId || shortId();
117: } catch {
118:   sessionId = shortId();
119: }
120: 
121: // Check for duplicate (re-save of same session)
122: const existingIdx = context.sessions.findIndex(s => s.id === sessionId);
123: 
124: const { summary, leftOff, nextSteps, decisions, blockers, goal } = input;
125: 
126: // Capture git activity since the last session
127: const lastSessionDate = context.sessions?.[context.sessions.length - 1]?.date;
128: const gitActivity = gitSummary(cwd, lastSessionDate);
129: 
130: const session = {
131:   id: sessionId,
132:   date: today(),
133:   summary: summary || 'Session saved',
134:   leftOff: leftOff || null,
135:   nextSteps: Array.isArray(nextSteps) ? nextSteps : (nextSteps ? [nextSteps] : []),
136:   decisions: Array.isArray(decisions) ? decisions : [],
137:   blockers: Array.isArray(blockers) ? blockers.filter(Boolean) : [],
138:   ...(gitActivity ? { gitActivity } : {}),
139: };
140: 
141: if (existingIdx >= 0) {
142:   // Update existing session (re-save)
143:   context.sessions[existingIdx] = session;
144: } else {
145:   context.sessions.push(session);
146: }
147: 
148: // Update goal if provided
149: if (goal && goal !== context.goal) {
150:   context.goal = goal;
151: }
152: 
153: // Save context.json + regenerate CONTEXT.md
154: saveContext(contextDir, context);
155: 
156: // Update projects.json timestamp
157: projects[cwd].lastUpdated = today();
158: writeProjects(projects);
159: 
160: // ── Write to native memory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
161: try {
162:   const memDir = nativeMemoryDir(cwd);
163:   mkdirSync(memDir, { recursive: true });
164: 
165:   const memFile = resolve(memDir, `ck_${today()}_${sessionId.slice(0, 8)}.md`);
166:   const decisionsBlock = session.decisions.length
167:     ? session.decisions.map(d => `- **${d.what}**: ${d.why || ''}`).join('\n')
168:     : '- None this session';
169:   const nextBlock = session.nextSteps.length
170:     ? session.nextSteps.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${s}`).join('\n')
171:     : '- None recorded';
172:   const blockersBlock = session.blockers.length
173:     ? session.blockers.map(b => `- ${b}`).join('\n')
174:     : '- None';
175: 
176:   const memContent = [
177:     `---`,
178:     `name: Session ${today()} — ${session.summary}`,
179:     `description: Key decisions and outcomes from ck session ${sessionId.slice(0, 8)}`,
180:     `type: project`,
181:     `source: ck`,
182:     `sessionId: ${sessionId}`,
183:     `---`,
184:     ``,
185:     `# Session: ${session.summary}`,
186:     ``,
187:     `## Decisions`,

1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: /**
3:  * ck — Context Keeper v2
4:  * migrate.mjs — convert v1 (CONTEXT.md + meta.json) to v2 (context.json)
5:  *
6:  * Usage:
7:  *   node migrate.mjs           — migrate all v1 projects
8:  *   node migrate.mjs --dry-run — preview without writing
9:  *
10:  * Safe: backs up meta.json to meta.json.v1-backup, never deletes data.
11:  * exit 0: success  exit 1: error
12:  */
13: 
14: import { readFileSync, existsSync, renameSync } from 'fs';
15: import { resolve } from 'path';
16: import { readProjects, writeProjects, saveContext, today, shortId, CONTEXTS_DIR } from './shared.mjs';
17: 
18: const isDryRun = process.argv.includes('--dry-run');
19: 
20: if (isDryRun) {
21:   console.log('ck migrate — DRY RUN (no files will be written)\n');
22: }
23: 
24: // ── v1 markdown parsers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
25: 
26: function extractSection(md, heading) {
27:   const re = new RegExp(`## ${heading}\\n([\\s\\S]*?)(?=\\n## |$)`);
28:   const m = md.match(re);
29:   return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
30: }
31: 
32: function parseBullets(text) {
33:   if (!text) return [];
34:   return text.split('\n')
35:     .filter(l => /^[-*\d]\s/.test(l.trim()))
36:     .map(l => l.replace(/^[-*\d]+\.?\s+/, '').trim())
37:     .filter(Boolean);
38: }
39: 
40: function parseDecisionsTable(text) {
41:   if (!text) return [];
42:   const rows = [];
43:   for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
44:     if (!line.startsWith('|') || line.match(/^[|\s-]+$/)) continue;
45:     const cols = line.split('|').map(c => c.trim()).filter((c, i) => i > 0 && i < 4);
46:     if (cols.length >= 1 && !cols[0].startsWith('Decision') && !cols[0].startsWith('_')) {
47:       rows.push({ what: cols[0] || '', why: cols[1] || '', date: cols[2] || '' });
48:     }
49:   }
50:   return rows;
51: }
52: 
53: /**
54:  * Parse "Where I Left Off" which in v1 can be:
55:  * - Simple bullet list
56:  * - Multi-session blocks: "Session N (date):\n- bullet\n"
57:  * Returns array of session-like objects {date?, leftOff}
58:  */
59: function parseLeftOff(text) {
60:   if (!text) return [{ leftOff: null }];
61: 
62:   // Detect multi-session format: "Session N ..."
63:   const sessionBlocks = text.split(/(?=Session \d+)/);
64:   if (sessionBlocks.length > 1) {
65:     return sessionBlocks
66:       .filter(b => b.trim())
67:       .map(block => {
68:         const dateMatch = block.match(/\((\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\)/);
69:         const bullets = parseBullets(block);
70:         return {
71:           date: dateMatch?.[1] || null,
72:           leftOff: bullets.length ? bullets.join('\n') : block.replace(/^Session \d+.*\n/, '').trim(),
73:         };
74:       });
75:   }
76: 
77:   // Simple format
78:   const bullets = parseBullets(text);
79:   return [{ leftOff: bullets.length ? bullets.join('\n') : text.trim() }];
80: }
81: 
82: // ── Main migration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
83: 
84: const projects = readProjects();
85: let migrated = 0;
86: let skipped = 0;
87: let errors = 0;
88: 
89: for (const [projectPath, info] of Object.entries(projects)) {
90:   const contextDir = info.contextDir;
91:   const contextDirPath = resolve(CONTEXTS_DIR, contextDir);
92:   const contextJsonPath = resolve(contextDirPath, 'context.json');
93:   const contextMdPath   = resolve(contextDirPath, 'CONTEXT.md');
94:   const metaPath        = resolve(contextDirPath, 'meta.json');
95: 
96:   // Already v2
97:   if (existsSync(contextJsonPath)) {
98:     try {
99:       const existing = JSON.parse(readFileSync(contextJsonPath, 'utf8'));
100:       if (existing.version === 2) {
101:         console.log(`  ✓ ${contextDir} — already v2, skipping`);
102:         skipped++;
103:         continue;
104:       }
105:     } catch { /* fall through to migrate */ }
106:   }
107: 
108:   console.log(`\n  → Migrating: ${contextDir}`);
109: 
110:   try {
111:     // Read v1 files
112:     const contextMd = existsSync(contextMdPath) ? readFileSync(contextMdPath, 'utf8') : '';
113:     let meta = {};
114:     if (existsSync(metaPath)) {
115:       try {
116:         meta = JSON.parse(readFileSync(metaPath, 'utf8'));
117:       } catch (e) {
118:         console.warn(`  ! ${contextDir}: invalid meta.json, continuing with defaults (${e.message})`);
119:       }
120:     }
121: 
122:     // Extract fields from CONTEXT.md
123:     const description   = extractSection(contextMd, 'What This Is') || extractSection(contextMd, 'About') || null;
124:     const stackRaw      = extractSection(contextMd, 'Tech Stack') || '';
125:     const stack         = stackRaw.split(/[,\n]/).map(s => s.replace(/^[-*]\s+/, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
126:     const goal          = (extractSection(contextMd, 'Current Goal') || '').split('\n')[0].trim() || null;
127:     const constraintRaw = extractSection(contextMd, 'Do Not Do') || '';
128:     const constraints   = parseBullets(constraintRaw);
129:     const decisionsRaw  = extractSection(contextMd, 'Decisions Made') || '';
130:     const decisions     = parseDecisionsTable(decisionsRaw);
131:     const nextStepsRaw  = extractSection(contextMd, 'Next Steps') || '';
132:     const nextSteps     = parseBullets(nextStepsRaw);
133:     const blockersRaw   = extractSection(contextMd, 'Blockers') || '';
134:     const blockers      = parseBullets(blockersRaw).filter(b => b.toLowerCase() !== 'none');
135:     const leftOffRaw    = extractSection(contextMd, 'Where I Left Off') || '';
136:     const leftOffParsed = parseLeftOff(leftOffRaw);
137: 
138:     // Build sessions from parsed left-off blocks (may be multiple)
139:     const sessions = leftOffParsed.map((lo, idx) => ({
140:       id: idx === leftOffParsed.length - 1 && meta.lastSessionId
141:         ? meta.lastSessionId.slice(0, 8)
142:         : shortId(),
143:       date: lo.date || meta.lastUpdated || today(),
144:       summary: idx === leftOffParsed.length - 1
145:         ? (meta.lastSessionSummary || 'Migrated from v1')
146:         : `Session ${idx + 1} (migrated)`,
147:       leftOff: lo.leftOff,
148:       nextSteps: idx === leftOffParsed.length - 1 ? nextSteps : [],
149:       decisions: idx === leftOffParsed.length - 1 ? decisions : [],
150:       blockers: idx === leftOffParsed.length - 1 ? blockers : [],
151:     }));
152: 
153:     const context = {
154:       version: 2,
155:       name: contextDir,
156:       path: meta.path || projectPath,
157:       description,
158:       stack,
159:       goal,
160:       constraints,
161:       repo: meta.repo || null,
162:       createdAt: meta.lastUpdated || today(),
163:       sessions,
164:     };
165: 
166:     if (isDryRun) {
167:       console.log(`    description: ${description?.slice(0, 60) || '(none)'}`);
168:       console.log(`    stack:       ${stack.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);
169:       console.log(`    goal:        ${goal?.slice(0, 60) || '(none)'}`);
170:       console.log(`    sessions:    ${sessions.length}`);
171:       console.log(`    decisions:   ${decisions.length}`);
172:       console.log(`    nextSteps:   ${nextSteps.length}`);
173:       migrated++;
174:       continue;
175:     }
176: 
177:     // Backup meta.json
178:     if (existsSync(metaPath)) {
179:       renameSync(metaPath, resolve(contextDirPath, 'meta.json.v1-backup'));
180:     }
181: 
182:     // Write context.json + regenerated CONTEXT.md
183:     saveContext(contextDir, context);
184: 
185:     // Update projects.json entry
186:     projects[projectPath].lastUpdated = today();
187: 
188:     console.log(`    ✓ Migrated — ${sessions.length} session(s), ${decisions.length} decision(s)`);
189:     migrated++;
190:   } catch (e) {
191:     console.log(`    ✗ Error: ${e.message}`);
192:     errors++;
193:   }
194: }
195: 
196: if (!isDryRun && migrated > 0) {
197:   writeProjects(projects);
198: }
199: 
200: console.log(`\nck migrate: ${migrated} migrated, ${skipped} already v2, ${errors} errors`);
201: if (isDryRun) console.log('Run without --dry-run to apply.');
202: if (errors > 0) process.exit(1);

(End of file - total 202 lines)
</content>

1: /**
2:  * ck — Context Keeper v2
3:  * shared.mjs — common utilities for all command scripts
4:  *
5:  * No external dependencies. Node.js stdlib only.
6:  */
7: 
8: import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync } from 'fs';
9: import { resolve } from 'path';
10: import { homedir } from 'os';
11: import { spawnSync } from 'child_process';
12: import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
13: 
14: // ─── Paths ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
15: 
16: export const CK_HOME          = resolve(homedir(), '.claude', 'ck');
17: export const CONTEXTS_DIR     = resolve(CK_HOME, 'contexts');
18: export const PROJECTS_FILE    = resolve(CK_HOME, 'projects.json');
19: export const CURRENT_SESSION  = resolve(CK_HOME, 'current-session.json');
20: export const SKILL_FILE       = resolve(homedir(), '.claude', 'skills', 'ck', 'SKILL.md');
21: 
22: // ─── JSON I/O ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
23: 
24: export function readJson(filePath) {
25:   try {
26:     if (!existsSync(filePath)) return null;
27:     return JSON.parse(readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8'));
28:   } catch {
29:     return null;
30:   }
31: }
32: 
33: export function writeJson(filePath, data) {
34:   const dir = resolve(filePath, '..');
35:   mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
36:   writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
37: }
38: 
39: export function readProjects() {
40:   return readJson(PROJECTS_FILE) || {};
41: }
42: 
43: export function writeProjects(projects) {
44:   writeJson(PROJECTS_FILE, projects);
45: }
46: 
47: // ─── Context I/O ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
48: 
49: export function contextPath(contextDir) {
50:   return resolve(CONTEXTS_DIR, contextDir, 'context.json');
51: }
52: 
53: export function contextMdPath(contextDir) {
54:   return resolve(CONTEXTS_DIR, contextDir, 'CONTEXT.md');
55: }
56: 
57: export function loadContext(contextDir) {
58:   return readJson(contextPath(contextDir));
59: }
60: 
61: export function saveContext(contextDir, data) {
62:   const dir = resolve(CONTEXTS_DIR, contextDir);
63:   mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
64:   writeJson(contextPath(contextDir), data);
65:   writeFileSync(contextMdPath(contextDir), renderContextMd(data), 'utf8');
66: }
67: 
68: /**
69:  * Resolve which project to operate on.
70:  * @param {string|undefined} arg  — undefined = cwd match, number string = alphabetical index, else name search
71:  * @param {string} cwd
72:  * @returns {{ name, contextDir, projectPath, context } | null}
73:  */
74: export function resolveContext(arg, cwd) {
75:   const projects = readProjects();
76:   const entries = Object.entries(projects); // [path, {name, contextDir, lastUpdated}]
77: 
78:   if (!arg) {
79:     // Match by cwd
80:     const entry = projects[cwd];
81:     if (!entry) return null;
82:     const context = loadContext(entry.contextDir);
83:     if (!context) return null;
84:     return { name: entry.name, contextDir: entry.contextDir, projectPath: cwd, context };
85:   }
86: 
87:   // Collect all contexts sorted alphabetically by contextDir
88:   const sorted = entries
89:     .map(([path, info]) => ({ path, ...info }))
90:     .sort((a, b) => a.contextDir.localeCompare(b.contextDir));
91: 
92:   const asNumber = parseInt(arg, 10);
93:   if (!isNaN(asNumber) && String(asNumber) === arg) {
94:     // Number-based lookup (1-indexed)
95:     const item = sorted[asNumber - 1];
96:     if (!item) return null;
97:     const context = loadContext(item.contextDir);
98:     if (!context) return null;
99:     return { name: item.name, contextDir: item.contextDir, projectPath: item.path, context };
100:   }
101: 
102:   // Name-based lookup: exact > prefix > substring (case-insensitive)
103:   const lower = arg.toLowerCase();
104:   let match =
105:     sorted.find(e => e.name.toLowerCase() === lower) ||
106:     sorted.find(e => e.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(lower)) ||
107:     sorted.find(e => e.name.toLowerCase().includes(lower));
108: 
109:   if (!match) return null;
110:   const context = loadContext(match.contextDir);
111:   if (!context) return null;
112:   return { name: match.name, contextDir: match.contextDir, projectPath: match.path, context };
113: }
114: 
115: // ─── Date helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
116: 
117: export function today() {
118:   return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
119: }
120: 
121: export function daysAgoLabel(dateStr) {
122:   if (!dateStr) return 'unknown';
123:   const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr)) / 86_400_000);
124:   if (diff === 0) return 'Today';
125:   if (diff === 1) return '1 day ago';
126:   return `${diff} days ago`;
127: }
128: 
129: export function stalenessIcon(dateStr) {
130:   if (!dateStr) return '○';
131:   const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr)) / 86_400_000);
132:   if (diff < 1) return '●';
133:   if (diff <= 5) return '◐';
134:   return '○';
135: }
136: 
137: // ─── ID generation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
138: 
139: export function shortId() {
140:   return randomBytes(4).toString('hex');
141: }
142: 
143: // ─── Git helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
144: 
145: function runGit(args, cwd) {
146:   try {
147:     const result = spawnSync('git', ['-C', cwd, ...args], {
148:       timeout: 3000,
149:       stdio: 'pipe',
150:       encoding: 'utf8',
151:     });
152:     if (result.status !== 0) return null;
153:     return result.stdout.trim();
154:   } catch {
155:     return null;
156:   }
157: }
158: 
159: export function gitLogSince(projectPath, sinceDate) {
160:   if (!sinceDate) return null;
161:   return runGit(['log', '--oneline', `--since=${sinceDate}`], projectPath);
162: }
163: 
164: export function gitSummary(projectPath, sinceDate) {
165:   const log = gitLogSince(projectPath, sinceDate);
166:   if (!log) return null;
167:   const commits = log.split('\n').filter(Boolean).length;
168:   if (commits === 0) return null;
169: 
170:   // Count unique files changed: use a separate runGit call to avoid nested shell substitution
171:   const countStr = runGit(['rev-list', '--count', 'HEAD', `--since=${sinceDate}`], projectPath);
172:   const revCount = countStr ? parseInt(countStr, 10) : commits;
173:   const diff = runGit(['diff', '--shortstat', `HEAD~${Math.min(revCount, 50)}..HEAD`], projectPath);
174: 
175:   if (diff) {
176:     const filesMatch = diff.match(/(\d+) file/);
177:     const files = filesMatch ? parseInt(filesMatch[1]) : '?';
178:     return `${commits} commit${commits !== 1 ? 's' : ''}, ${files} file${files !== 1 ? 's' : ''} changed`;
179:   }
180:   return `${commits} commit${commits !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
181: }
182: 
183: // ─── Native memory path encoding ──────────────────────────────────────────────
184: 
185: export function encodeProjectPath(absolutePath) {
186:   // "/Users/sree/dev/app" -> "-Users-sree-dev-app"
187:   return absolutePath.replace(/\//g, '-');
188: }
189: 
190: export function nativeMemoryDir(absolutePath) {
191:   const encoded = encodeProjectPath(absolutePath);
192:   return resolve(homedir(), '.claude', 'projects', encoded, 'memory');
193: }
194: 
195: // ─── Rendering ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
196: 
197: /** Render the human-readable CONTEXT.md from context.json */
198: export function renderContextMd(ctx) {
199:   const latest = ctx.sessions?.[ctx.sessions.length - 1] || null;
200:   const lines = [
201:     `<!-- Generated by ck v2 — edit context.json instead -->`,
202:     `# Project: ${ctx.displayName ?? ctx.name}`,
203:     `> Path: ${ctx.path}`,
204:   ];
205:   if (ctx.repo) lines.push(`> Repo: ${ctx.repo}`);
206:   const sessionCount = ctx.sessions?.length || 0;
207:   lines.push(`> Last Session: ${ctx.sessions?.[sessionCount - 1]?.date || 'never'} | Sessions: ${sessionCount}`);
208:   lines.push(``);
209:   lines.push(`## What This Is`);
210:   lines.push(ctx.description || '_Not set._');
211:   lines.push(``);
212:   lines.push(`## Tech Stack`);
213:   lines.push(Array.isArray(ctx.stack) ? ctx.stack.join(', ') : (ctx.stack || '_Not set._'));
214:   lines.push(``);

225:     lines.push(`_Not yet recorded._`);

227:   lines.push(``);

234:   lines.push(``);

246:   );
247:   lines.push(`## Decisions Made`);

252:   } else {

254:   }
255:   lines.push(``);
256:

258:   if (ctx.sessions?.length > 1) {
259:     lines.push(`## Session History`);
260:     const reversed = [...ctx.sessions].reverse();
261:     reversed.forEach(s => {
262:       lines.push(`### ${s.date} — ${s.summary || 'Session'}`);
263:       if (s.gitActivity) lines.push(`_${s.gitActivity}_`);
264:       if (s.leftOff) lines.push(`**Left off:** ${s.leftOff}`);

266:     lines.push(``);

269:   return lines.join('\n');

272: /** Render the bordered briefing box used by /ck:resume */
273: export function renderBriefingBox(ctx, _meta = {}) {
274:   const latest = ctx.sessions?.[ctx.sessions.length - 1] || {};
275:   const W = 57;
276:   const pad = (str, w) => {
277:     const s = String(str || '');
278:     return s.length > w ? s.slice(0, w - 1) + '…' : s.padEnd(w);
279:   };
280:   const row = (label, value) => `│  ${label} → ${pad(value, W - label.length - 7)}│`;
281: 
282:   const when = daysAgoLabel(ctx.sessions?.[ctx.sessions.length - 1]?.date);
283:   const sessions = ctx.sessions?.length || 0;
284:   const shortSessId = latest.id?.slice(0, 8) || null;
285: 
286:   const lines = [
287:     `┌${'─'.repeat(W)}┐`,
288:     `│  RESUMING: ${pad(ctx.displayName ?? ctx.name, W - 12)}│`,
289:     `│  Last session: ${pad(`${when}  |  Sessions: ${sessions}`, W - 16)}│`,
290:   ];
291:   if (shortSessId) lines.push(`│  Session ID: ${pad(shortSessId, W - 14)}│`);
292:   lines.push(`├${'─'.repeat(W)}┤`);
293:   lines.push(row('WHAT IT IS', ctx.description || '—'));
294:   lines.push(row('STACK     ', Array.isArray(ctx.stack) ? ctx.stack.join(', ') : (ctx.stack || '—')));
295:   lines.push(row('PATH      ', ctx.path));
296:   if (ctx.repo) lines.push(row('REPO      ', ctx.repo));
297:   lines.push(row('GOAL      ', ctx.goal || '—'));
298:   lines.push(`├${'─'.repeat(W)}┤`);
299:   lines.push(`│  WHERE I LEFT OFF${' '.repeat(W - 18)}│`);
300:   const leftOffLines = (latest.leftOff || '—').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
301:   leftOffLines.forEach(l => lines.push(`│    • ${pad(l, W - 7)}│`));
302:   lines.push(`├${'─'.repeat(W)}┤`);
303:   lines.push(`│  NEXT STEPS${' '.repeat(W - 12)}│`);
304:   const steps = latest.nextSteps || [];
305:   if (steps.length) {
306:     steps.forEach((s, i) => lines.push(`│    ${i + 1}. ${pad(s, W - 8)}│`));
307:   } else {
308:     lines.push(`│    —${' '.repeat(W - 5)}│`);
309:   }
310:   const blockers = latest.blockers?.length ? latest.blockers.join(', ') : 'None';
311:   lines.push(`│  BLOCKERS → ${pad(blockers, W - 13)}│`);
312:   if (latest.gitActivity) {
313:     lines.push(`│  GIT      → ${pad(latest.gitActivity, W - 13)}│`);
314:   }
315:   lines.push(`└${'─'.repeat(W)}┘`);
316:   return lines.join('\n');
317: }
